consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: Ba7dhek needs your agreement to use your data. Here is what happens to it.
consent.collect: Your name and photo from your account, what you write in your profile, a starting point you choose on the map, your applications and your messages.
consent.share: When you swipe right on a job, that employer sees your name, your photo, your profile text and a distance range. Nobody ever sees your starting point.
consent.where: On servers outside Tunisia, in the European Union and the United States.
consent.rights: You can correct your data, ask for a copy, or delete your account at any time from Settings.
consent.declinedBody: Ba7dhek cannot work without this agreement. Nothing about you has been saved beyond your sign-in.
consent.failed: Your agreement was not saved. Try again.
